name: Velvet Signal: Private Messages
source: Ten days of private messages with Elizabeth, a mysterious cyberpunk model. Earn her trust, make meaningful choices, unlock explicit scenes, and decide whether you will remain a viewer or become someone real to her.
translation: 与神秘赛博朋克女模特伊丽莎白私信往来的十天时光。赢得她的信任、做出关键抉择、解锁露骨火辣的场景，并决定你究竟只是停留于屏幕外的看客，还是成为她生命中真实可触的那个人。
